recommendations.title: Protect identity and exit
recommendations.proposal: Anchor the inspector inside its Media workspace below the page heading/search and global navigation. Keep Filename and Close visible while panel content scrolls. Use the approved quiet Close control.

recommendations.title: Dock only when browsing remains usable
recommendations.proposal: Keep the current inspector width. Dock only when the remaining file area supports at least two existing minimum-size grid columns; use a right overlay otherwise. List mode needs its own readable-column check. Do not collapse navigation automatically. Global 1440 with all location rails should use overlay; a project view with enough room can remain docked.
recommendations.tradeoff: Overlay covers browsing while open at constrained widths, but avoids reflowing the grid into a sliver and preserves location.

recommendations.title: Make entry and exit predictable
recommendations.proposal: Correct Media grid/list child keyboard activation so Select selects and opening opens. Keyboard opening moves focus into the inspector; Close or Escape returns focus to the opening file. Inner menus handle Escape first. Retain non-modal background access and no click-away dismissal.
recommendations.scope: Shared Media inspector and its Media card/list entry controls. Transcript paragraph fix is outside this first pass.

recommendations.title: Protect context and unfinished work
recommendations.proposal: Preserve current Client/project/folder, query, selected files and list scroll on close. A non-empty unsent comment triggers the existing DS confirmation pattern before closing or switching asset: keep editing or discard. Preserve existing rename save behaviour and action permissions.
recommendations.classification: Proposed safeguard for new dismissal behaviour; not an observed data-loss claim
